feature.name: Original static-page composer
feature.objective: Let the user assemble, edit, reorder and export a responsive original page with a compatible design token theme, without running external component source.
feature.audience: Designers and developers preparing starter pages
acceptance_criteria: Provide five original section types with keyboard-accessible select/up/down/remove controls.
Support editing text and links with validated bounds, up to 16 sections.
Allow responsive preview and reusing saved theme from Design Token Studio.
Export safe standalone HTML and editable JSON; validated import and best-effort browser-local persistence.
Preserve existing workbench behavior and pass all automated checks.

source_of_truth.authority_rule: Original content templates, not copied third-party sites; treat external UI catalogues as references only.

tokens.theme_source: validated saved Design Token Studio theme

design_system.contrast_review: Requires final page audit; token studio performs two color-pair checks only.

component_registry.purpose: Hero, features, highlights, callout and footer

interactions.success_condition: Live preview and local project updated
Selected section changes position without data loss
Standalone HTML or portable project JSON produced locally
interactions.failure_condition: Browser download failure surfaced by browser

motion_ownership.reduced_motion_behavior: Transition disabled when reduced motion is preferred

tool_runs.decisions: No new runtime dependencies or remote third-party code
Test portable exports and mobile/desktop flow

quality_gates.security_review: Strict schema; text escape; no arbitrary HTML, external URLs or code evaluation

decisions.decision: Native keyboard-selectable move up/down controls instead of drag-and-drop library
decisions.reason: Dependency-free, accessible and simpler to maintain.

decisions.decision: Single-file HTML export rather than framework app generation
decisions.reason: Delivers a usable, portable first version without pretending arbitrary external components are executable.

handoff.next_stage: verify tests and browser behaviors then merge
